name: Email Formatting - No Spaces
description: Emails must not contain spaces. This causes parsing errors and looks unprofessional.
error_message: Email address contains spaces or invalid characters.

name: Email Formatting - Acronym Usage
description: Email aliases should be concise acronyms (e.g., 'PSE') not full titles (e.g., 'Principal_Software_Engineer') to prevent excessive length.
error_message: Email alias is too long (>35 chars). Likely using full title instead of acronym.

name: No Markdown Formatting
description: Resume fields must be plain text. Markdown (bold, italics, links) causes rendering errors in JSON Resume themes.
error_message: Markdown formatting detected (bold, italics, or links). Use plain text only.

name: Missing Company Name
description: Every work entry must have a 'name' field indicating the employer.
error_message: One or more work entries are missing the 'name' (Company) field.

name: Profile URL Enforcement
description: Profile usernames must be full URLs to ensure they print correctly.
error_message: Profile username is not a full URL (must start with http/https).

name: Skill Section Layout Alignment
description: The skills array must contain exactly 2 or 5 categories to align with the certifications column for a balanced 3 or 6 column layout.
error_message: Skills array length must be exactly 2 or 5 to ensure layout alignment.

name: Concise Highlights - 105 Char Limit
description: Each highlight bullet must be 105 characters or less to prevent line-wrapping in the rendered PDF.
error_message: One or more highlights exceed the 105-character limit. Rewrite for brevity.
